# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Changes from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. Several results were irrelevant (sports, retail, and unrelated "Stripe" mentions) and were excluded.

## Launches and product

- **Global Payouts stablecoin wallets:** US businesses can send stablecoin payouts directly to crypto wallets in more than 160 markets. The capability launched in public preview in early November 2026. (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716)
- **MiniPay and Link by Stripe:** MiniPay's integration with Link by Stripe, which gives users a one-click fiat-to-stablecoin onramp, was scheduled for 12 November 2026. MiniPay has more than 20 million wallets. The source describes it as scheduled, so confirm it went live. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026)

## Customers and partners

- **Anthropic:** Stripe is named among customers, alongside Bridgewater and Salesforce, for Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which is in private beta. (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2)

## Deals

- **OpenRouter, Inc.:** Listed on Stripe's profile as an acquisition dated 1 August 2026, with a listed value of 7.50B USD. This falls outside the 30-day window and is included for context. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy)
- **Clerky, Inc.:** Listed as an acquisition dated 1 August 2026, with no further detail. Also outside the window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy)

## Hires

- No hiring news was found in the results.

## Market context

- **AI agents and payments:** Reporting says Meta's personal AI assistants have recently been enabled to make purchases on cardholders' behalf, and banks are racing to respond. The excerpt does not name Stripe. (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30)

## Gaps

- No verified information on hires, leadership changes, earnings, or regulatory matters.
- The Stripe company profile is undated, so its deal entries should be checked against primary sources.

## Open questions

1. What is the timeline from the stablecoin payouts public preview to general availability, and which of the 160+ markets are in scope first?
2. How is Stripe positioning payments initiated by AI agents, given the reported consumer AI purchasing moves and its role as an Anthropic enterprise customer?
3. How is the OpenRouter acquisition being integrated, and does it affect Stripe's plans for stablecoin and developer payments?
